name: Riptide Gauntlet
introDiscord:
A violent riptide threads through ribs and wrecks ahead. Riptide
Hammerheads use the narrow channels like an obstacle course.
introTwitch:
A violent riptide threads through ribs and wrecks ahead. Riptide
Hammerheads use the narrow channels like an obstacle course.

riptide-gauntlet-approach.prompt: Three current lanes weave around shattered hulls.

left.message: Star Candies rest beneath an immense scale outside the strongest tide.

right.message:
A Hammerhead shoots around the wreck and nearly clips the rib beside
you.

Excellent turning radius.

Terrible manners.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Current obstacle course attempt #1.

Result:

I became obstacle.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the course-recovery medicine untouched.

left.message: A Riptide Hammerhead races through a gap barely wider than itself.

right.message: A navigator's chest rests behind a wrecked keel.

forward.message:
One Berry sits beside a little scorecard:

'Shizuki: 4 gates.

Glimmer: all gates because Glimmer CHEATED by floating over them.'

riptide-gauntlet-threshold.prompt: Hammer Current surges beyond three final lanes.

left.message:
Shizuki's bottle says:

'Attempt #2.

Improvement:

Was obstacle for shorter period.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the athletic medicine unused.

right.message:
A Hammerhead powers directly against the current before turning toward
you.

forward.message: A strongbox has lodged behind a giant vertebra.

boss-antechamber.name: Hammer Current
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every ordinary Hammerhead clears the Gauntlet.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every ordinary Hammerhead clears the Gauntlet.

Something enormous begins driving straight through the strongest
current.

Use /yes to enter Hammer Current or /no to retire from Shizuki's
unofficial obstacle course.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every ordinary Hammerhead clears the Gauntlet.

Something enormous begins driving straight through the strongest
current.

Use !yes to enter Hammer Current or !no to retire from Shizuki's
unofficial obstacle course.
bossRetreatText: You leave the course with dignity mostly intact.

boss.revealText:
A massive Hammerhead breaks through the tide.

Breakerhead Patriarch reveals itself!

completionText:
The Patriarch disappears down the Gauntlet.

Glimmer's record remains unbeatable.

Cheater.
